free_tier_limits: Starter: 500 test results/month, 50 users, and 30-day retention. The Data Extract API itself requires an Enterprise plan.
description: Enterprise-only HTTP Data Extract API for exporting Cypress Cloud Enterprise Reporting data, including projects, runs, test results, failures, replay links, UI coverage, and accessibility metrics, in JSON, CSV, or XLSX. It is not a general REST API at api.cypress.io; read-oriented run debugging on other plans is provided through the cy-cloud CLI.
